package.name: flight_driver
package.description: Real-vehicle flight FSM for the A4VAI apps (from A4VAI-Flight-Test path_following_test, flown on the X500): PX4 AUTO_TAKEOFF relative to the ground the vehicle rests on, OFFBOARD in the air, PathFollowing attitude forwarded to PX4, landing. Missions: local or GPS waypoints for PathFollowing, or a goal for the learned collision avoidance. Yields to the pilot, never re-arms, lands on lost inputs.
